usageNotes: Creates a named IPSet on an LXC container's firewall, which can then be populated with IP/CIDR entries and referenced in firewall rules. The caller needs VM.Config.Network on the container. The 'rename' param doubles as an in-place update: pass it with the same value as 'name' to update only the comment on an existing IPSet without recreating it.

examples.summary: Create an IPSet named 'trusted-mgmt' for management traffic on LXC 110

tips: IPSet names must start with a letter and match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+ (2–64 chars) — purely numeric names are rejected.
Creating the IPSet is a two-step process: create it here, then add individual IP/CIDR entries via the corresponding PUT endpoint for IPSet members.
Use the 'digest' param when scripting concurrent changes to avoid race conditions overwriting the firewall config.
Returns null on success — check for a 2xx HTTP status rather than parsing a body.
